record.paper_title: Constructive Field Theory and Applications: Perspectives and Open Problems
record.original_question: Develop constructive field theory in curved space-time.

evidence.quote: Develop constructive field theory in curved space-time.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Constructive quantum field theory aims to give mathematically rigorous, non-perturbative constructions of interacting quantum field theory models, typically by defining a probability measure on a space of distributions (in the Euclidean formulation) or a Wightman/Haag–Kastler theory (in the Lorentzian/algebraic formulation) that satisfies suitable axioms (Osterwalder–Schrader axioms in the Euclidean case, Wightman or Haag–Kastler axioms in the relativistic case). The classical successes of this program concern theories on flat Minkowski or Euclidean spacetime R^d, where translation and Lorentz (or rotation) invariance play a crucial role in renormalization, cluster expansions, and the verification of axioms.

Problem. Develop a non-perturbative constructive framework for interacting quantum field theories on a general (globally hyperbolic) curved Lorentzian spacetime (M, g), or on a Riemannian manifold in the Euclidean setting. Concretely, formulate and carry out the following:

(a) Give a precise set of axioms for an interacting quantum field theory on a curved background (M, g) that reduces to the Wightman/Osterwalder–Schrader axioms when (M, g) is Minkowski/Euclidean space, incorporating local covariance and the absence of a preferred vacuum.

(b) Construct at least one non-trivial interacting model satisfying these axioms on a class of curved spacetimes that are not globally flat — for example, a scalar field with polynomial self-interaction (such as φ^4) in two or three spacetime dimensions on a curved background — including a rigorous, non-perturbative definition of the interacting measure or the interacting field algebra, and a proof of renormalizability and of the relevant axioms.

(c) Establish the appropriate analogues of Euclidean techniques (reflection positivity, cluster expansions, multiscale/renormalization-group analysis) on curved manifolds, or alternative tools sufficient for such constructions.
artifact.status_search_result: Constructive QFT on curved spacetime is a long-standing open program. Perturbative algebraic QFT on curved spacetimes (Brunetti–Fredenhagen–Verch and subsequent work) is well developed, and there are rigorous non-perturbative results for free and superrenormalizable models on specific backgrounds, but a general non-perturbative constructive theory of interacting QFT on curved spacetime remains an open research direction.

status_evidence.title: Quantum Field Theory on Curved Spacetimes (review)
status_evidence.snippet: Perturbative algebraic approach to QFT on curved spacetime; non-perturbative interacting constructions remain a major open problem.
status_evidence.claim: Non-perturbative constructive QFT on curved backgrounds is not yet achieved in general.
